summary: Implemented the accessible Impact Planner interface, DOM projection helpers, responsive and reduced-motion styling, and static interface tests in the four declared files. Scoped Node tests passed: 3/3. view.js syntax check passed.

artifacts.name: impact-interface-handoff.md
artifacts.content: Implemented examples/impact-planner/index.html with stable semantic IDs, component template, forms, summaries, tables, alerts, live announcements, and import/export/reset controls. Implemented src/view.js exports for draft reading, component and impact projection, error rendering, announcements, and reduced-motion scroll behavior. Implemented styles.css with visible focus, 44px targets, responsive layouts, overflow-safe tables, forced-colors support, and reduced-motion rules. Added test/interface.test.mjs covering stable hooks, projection exports, responsive behavior, and reduced motion. Verification: node --test examples\\impact-planner\\test\\interface.test.mjs passed 3 tests; node --check examples\\impact-planner\\src\\view.js passed.
